en.name: Dal (split pulses)
en.summary: Dal is the family of dried split, usually hulled pulses — toor, moong, chana, urad, masoor. In an airtight container in a cool, dark cupboard they keep about 12 months, and about the same again once the bag is opened and they are decanted properly. What ends them is hardening, not spoilage.
en.pantry: An airtight container in a cool, dry, dark cupboard is the whole method, and it gives about 12 months — the same 12 months applies from the day you open the bag, provided you decant it into a sealed jar straight away rather than rolling the top down. Two things go wrong slowly: light bleaches the colour, and oxygen turns the small amount of oil in the seed. A third goes wrong faster, which is pantry weevils. Bay leaves in the jar are folklore; a genuinely airtight jar is not. Oiled toor dal, sold with a light film of oil to deter insects, should be rinsed in warm water before cooking.
en.fridge: No refrigerator timeline is published for dal, so none is given here. Cold storage does extend the life of any dried pulse, and in a hot, humid kitchen an airtight jar in the fridge is a reasonable choice — bring it back to room temperature before opening so moisture condenses on the jar and not on the dal. Cooked dal is a different food entirely: cool it fast, refrigerate it covered, and reheat it until it is steaming hot rather than merely warm.
en.freezer: No freezer figure is given for dal either. Freezing a sealed bag for a couple of days is a genuinely useful way to deal with insect eggs in a bulk purchase, and long freezing slows the seed oil oxidising, but neither is a published shelf life and this page will not turn a habit into a number. Cooked dal freezes well and is the more useful thing to put in a freezer.
spoilage: Live weevils, fine dust, webbing, or small holes bored in the seeds.
A musty or mouldy smell, meaning damp has got into the jar.
Dal that will not soften after a long soak and a long simmer — an age problem rather than a safety one.
A rancid or bitter smell, especially in oiled toor dal that has been kept warm.
tips: Decant every bag into an airtight jar on the day you buy it and date the lid.
Split and hulled dals have more cut surface than whole pulses and stale faster — buy them in smaller quantities.
Rinse oiled toor dal in warm water before cooking.
Do not top up an old jar with a new bag; finish the old one first.

faq.a: About 12 months in an airtight container in a cool, dark cupboard, and about 12 months from opening if you decant it properly.

faq.q: Is old dal safe to eat?
faq.a: Usually, if it has been kept dry and free of insects. The real problem is that the seeds harden with age, so it needs longer soaking and cooking and may never soften properly.

faq.q: Does dal need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. An airtight jar in a cool, dark cupboard is enough. Cold helps in a very humid kitchen, but there is no published figure for it.

faq.q: Why is my toor dal oily?
faq.a: Some toor dal is sold with a light coating of oil to deter insects. Rinse it in warm water before cooking.

zh.name: 印度乾豆瓣
zh.summary: Dal 泛指各種乾燥、去皮、剖半的豆類——木豆（toor）、綠豆（moong）、鷹嘴豆瓣（chana）、黑豆仁（urad）、紅扁豆（masoor）。裝密封容器放陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 12 個月；開封後只要立刻換裝密封罐，一樣大約 12 個月。終結它的是變硬，不是腐敗。
zh.pantry: 方法就是一句話：密封容器、陰涼乾燥避光的櫥櫃，大約 12 個月——而且只要你一開封就立刻倒進密封罐（而不是把袋口捲起來了事），開封後同樣約 12 個月。兩件事慢慢發生：光線讓顏色褪掉，氧氣讓種子裡少量的油脂變質。另一件發生得快，就是櫥櫃裡的米象。罐裡放月桂葉是民間說法；真正密封的罐子才有效。有些木豆瓣表面裹了一層薄油防蟲，煮之前請用溫水沖洗乾淨。
zh.fridge: Dal 沒有公布的冷藏期限，本頁也不給。低溫確實能延長任何乾豆的壽命，濕熱的廚房裡把密封罐放冰箱是合理的選擇——開封前先回到室溫，讓水氣凝在罐子外面而不是豆子上。煮熟的 dal 則完全是另一種食物：快速降溫、加蓋冷藏，復熱要熱到冒蒸氣，不能只是溫熱。
zh.freezer: Dal 也沒有給冷凍數字。把密封袋冷凍個幾天，是處理大量採購時蟲卵問題的實用做法，長期冷凍也能延緩種子油脂氧化，但兩者都不是有出處的保存期限，本頁不會把習慣寫成數字。真正值得放冷凍庫的是煮好的 dal，它很耐凍。
spoilage: 看到活的米象、細粉屑、絲網，或豆子上有蛀孔。
聞到潮霉味，代表濕氣已經跑進罐子裡。
泡很久、煮很久還是不軟——這是年紀問題，不是安全問題。
聞到油耗或苦味，尤其是裹油的木豆瓣放在溫熱處之後。
tips: 每一包買回來當天就倒進密封罐，並在蓋子上寫日期。
剖半去皮的豆瓣比整顆豆暴露的斷面多、走味更快，請少量買。
裹油的木豆瓣煮前先用溫水沖洗。
不要把新的一包倒進舊罐裡補滿；先把舊的用完。

faq.q: 印度乾豆瓣可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封容器、陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 12 個月；開封後只要確實換裝密封罐，也是約 12 個月。

faq.q: 放很久的 dal 還能吃嗎？
faq.a: 只要一直乾燥、沒生蟲，通常可以。真正的問題是種子會隨年紀變硬，要泡更久煮更久，甚至怎麼煮都不軟。
不需要。密封罐放陰涼避光的櫥櫃就夠了。非常潮濕的廚房低溫會有幫助，但沒有公布的數字可引用。

faq.q: 我的木豆瓣為什麼油油的？
faq.a: 有些木豆瓣出廠時會裹一層薄油防蟲。煮之前用溫水沖洗掉即可。
